nl: 项目管理：查询项目名称；表格用两级表头——「项目」下分「项目名称」「负责人」，另一列是「进度」；项目是树形结构，子任务放在 subTasks 字段里，默认全部展开；支持新增、编辑、删除。
nlEn: Project management: query by project name; the table has two-level group headers — "Project" grouping "Project name" and "Owner", plus a "Progress" column; projects are hierarchical with sub-tasks under the subTasks field and all nodes start expanded; supports add, edit and delete.
notes: AI-09 子项③+①: 树表 + 多级表头显式列（childrenField=subTasks + expandAll）（vue3/schema）
